props.name: children
props.description: The link text. Name the destination, as in "Read the invoice help articles", not "click here". An inline SVG after the text, marked `data-icon="inline-end"`, draws one `em` square in the link's colour and stays on the last word's line. Mark one before the text `data-icon="inline-start"`.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: another page, a section of this page, or a file. For an action, such as opening a dialog or saving a form, use a Button. A screen reader announces a link as a link, and Space does not activate it.

props.name: render
props.description: Your router's link element, with its own destination prop, such as `<NextLink href="/invoices/1042" />` or React Router's `<RouterLink to="/invoices/1042" />`. Link merges its classes, `data-slot` and props onto it, and the router handles the click. A `className` on the element, a string or a state callback, merges after Link's classes and wins a conflict.

props.name: target
props.description: Set `_blank`, with `rel="noreferrer"`, to open another site in a new tab. Say that the link opens a new tab in text a screen reader reads, such as an `sr-only` span in `children`.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Cuts a long link to its container's width with an ellipsis. Give the link a box to fit, such as a flex row with a set width, and keep the full text in reach, such as on the page it opens.

props.name: underline
props.description: How a reader tells the link from its sentence. `always` underlines at rest in a dimmed line and draws it in the full colour under the pointer. Keep it in running text, where nothing else marks the link. `hover` underlines only under the pointer, for a place that already reads as links, such as a row of footer links. `none` never underlines and fades the text under the pointer, for a link a container marks, such as a card's title.

props.name: variant
props.description: The text colour. `default` takes the colour of the text around it, so a link in an error message is the error colour. The others set a text role. Some themes set `primary` to the text colour, so keep the underline wherever colour is the only other difference.

props.name: weight
props.description: The link's own weight. Unset, the link takes the weight of its sentence, as it always takes the sentence's font, size and line height.
